items.title: Efficiency meets scale
items.narration: AI can become more efficient and still use much more electricity. IEA projects global data-center use rising from 485 TWh in 2025 to 950 TWh in 2030.

items.title: The infrastructure mismatch
items.narration: Berkeley Lab models a wide U.S. range for 2030. The uncertainty matters: the challenge is the speed mismatch between deployment and the infrastructure expected to power it.
